# dsh-ouroboros 配置桥 > 通过 DSH MCP client 挂载 Ouroboros 工作流工具。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[Q00/ouroboros](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros) - **版本号**：0.1.0（[固定提交 722172ef096767583679d04aef5e847458fee6b2](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/tree/722172ef096767583679d04aef5e847458fee6b2)） - **版本日期**：2026-10-30（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 固定配置显示命令和显式参数；宿主行为、动态引擎、后端和模型调用本轮未运行。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：已使用 Ouroboros、希望在 DSH 对话调用的开发者；替代为手写 MCP 配置或直接 CLI。[Q01](#research-q01) - **亮点**：可安装的默认配置减少手工接线；上游访谈和执行能力不属于桥自身。[Q01](#research-q01) - **思考**：工具可见不等于后端可调用；动态解析使固定配置不能固定实际执行的引擎版本。[Q02](#research-q02) [Q03](#research-q03) - **建议**：未验证假设：显示实际引擎版本及后端预检可减少首个访谈失败，须对照现有文档测误报和泄露。[Q05](#research-q05) 采用建议：固定引擎版本、确认凭据与预算，先验证访谈及产物；故障时重载或回退 CLI。[Q04](#research-q04) ## 核心贡献 可安装的默认配置减少手工接线；上游访谈和执行能力不属于桥自身。[Q01](#research-q01) ## 关键质疑 工具可见不等于后端可调用；动态解析使固定配置不能固定实际执行的引擎版本。[Q02](#research-q02) [Q03](#research-q03) ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 未验证假设：显示实际引擎版本及后端预检可减少首个访谈失败，须对照现有文档测误报和泄露。[Q05](#research-q05) 固定宿主与引擎，在隔离项目核验工具注册、访谈后端、执行及故障恢复。 ## 场景与替代办法 已使用 Ouroboros、希望在 DSH 对话调用的开发者；替代为手写 MCP 配置或直接 CLI。[Q01](#research-q01) 手工编写 MCP stdio 配置或使用独立 CLI。[Q01](#research-q01) ## 依赖与流程 | 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失时 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | DSH MCP client | 必需 | 挂载工具 | 无桥接 | | uv、Python 3.12 | 启动必需 | 拉取运行引擎 | 服务不可启动 | | 对应后端和凭据 | 工作流必需 | 访谈和执行 | 调用失败 | | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 判据或失败处理 | | --- | --- | --- | | 准备 | 固定引擎与宿主 | 核对配置及预算 | | 访谈 | 非敏感测试任务 | 检查 Seed 与后端 | | 执行 | 分步执行与评估 | 失败停止并检查 | ## 成本与效果 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 首次 | 下载和环境成本 | 版本与后端配置 | 动态引擎未锁 | | 持续 | 模型和执行费用未知 | 审核产物 | 节约未经验证 | | 恢复 | 重试可能耗费模型 | 修复后重载 | 自动重连依宿主 | | 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 | | --- | --- | --- | | MCP 接线 | patch 声明启动参数 | 实际工具注册 | | 规格流程 | 作者描述上游能力 | 访谈与执行成功 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：固定 DSH 配置桥如何挂载 Ouroboros，引擎版本和后端就绪有何边界？ ### Q01 · 谁需要此配置桥，其价值与上游边界是什么？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势、依赖、兼容与流程 #### 完整回答 面向已决定使用 Ouroboros 规格驱动流程、想在 DSH 对话发起而非切换 CLI 的用户。手工等效 MCP 配置或直接 CLI 是基线；本包只声明一个 DSH MCP client 配置，提供超时、环境和启动容错默认值，访谈、Seed、执行与评估引擎属于上游。作者列出的工具数和模型自动选择仅为声明，不能证明宿主和工作流已可用。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[integrations/dsh-plugin/README.md:3-12](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/722172ef096767583679d04aef5e847458fee6b2/integrations/dsh-plugin/README.md#L3-L12) 作者说明配置桥及工作流归属。
查看原文（10行） ```text Mount [Ouroboros](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros) — a spec-first AI dev workflow engine (Socratic interview → Seed spec → execute → evaluate → evolve) — into [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) as native tools. Once installed, type `ooo interview ` or `ooo auto ` directly in the dsh chat — the model finds and calls the matching `mcp__ouroboros__*` tool on its own. This is a **config-only bundle**: it contains no custom plugin code, just one row that mounts dsh's existing `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` against `ouroboros mcp serve`. ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[integrations/dsh-plugin/package.json:19-26](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/722172ef096767583679d04aef5e847458fee6b2/integrations/dsh-plugin/package.json#L19-L26) 发行文件与 patch 入口。 ```text "files": [ "cordis.patch.yml", "README.md" ], "dsh": { "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" } ``` **依据 3 · 源码核查**：[integrations/dsh-plugin/cordis.patch.yml:43-57](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/722172ef096767583679d04aef5e847458fee6b2/integrations/dsh-plugin/cordis.patch.yml#L43-L57) 配置一条 MCP stdio 行。
查看原文（15行） ```text - insert: - id: mcp-ouroboros name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client' config: serverName: ouroboros transport: stdio command: uvx args: - --from - 'ouroboros-ai[mcp]' - --with - 'mcp==2.3.0' - ouroboros - mcp - serve ```
#### 缺口 - 本轮未运行 DSH、MCP、uvx 或模型 **影响**：无法证明工具注册、后端可用与真实任务成功 **进一步探讨**：锁定引擎和宿主版本后用隔离项目核验 ### Q02 · 插件如何启动服务并转发配置？ **研究主题**：功能与机制、工程质量与复用 #### 完整回答 patch 插入 DSH MCP client，使用 uvx --from ouroboros-ai[mcp] --with mcp==2.3.0 ouroboros mcp serve；MCP 依赖版本固定而 Ouroboros 包本身未锁，固定本仓提交不固定实际拉取引擎。显式配置两个 API 密钥及选择器，runtime 未设时选 host，超时 1800000 ms，启动错误不致命。环境清洗和配置覆盖是文件注释对宿主的描述，未经本轮宿主实测，凭据仍可能被明确发送至子进程。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[integrations/dsh-plugin/cordis.patch.yml:43-57](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/722172ef096767583679d04aef5e847458fee6b2/integrations/dsh-plugin/cordis.patch.yml#L43-L57) 命令参数及版本选择。
查看原文（15行） ```text - insert: - id: mcp-ouroboros name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client' config: serverName: ouroboros transport: stdio command: uvx args: - --from - 'ouroboros-ai[mcp]' - --with - 'mcp==2.3.0' - ouroboros - mcp - serve ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[integrations/dsh-plugin/cordis.patch.yml:58-71](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/722172ef096767583679d04aef5e847458fee6b2/integrations/dsh-plugin/cordis.patch.yml#L58-L71) 作者描述宿主环境清洗及覆盖。
查看原文（14行） ```text # The child does NOT inherit the harness environment wholesale: # @deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess hands mcp-client a scrubbed parent env # with every credential-shaped name (/KEY|PASSWORD|SECRET|TOKEN/i) and # every DSH_* name removed, precisely so harness credentials never leak # into a spawned process implicitly. This explicit layer merges *after* # that scrub, so any credential Ouroboros genuinely needs has to be # named here. It is deliberately a short allowlist covering the two # documented backends — not a wildcard passthrough. To forward another # (OPENAI_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, GOOGLE_API_KEY, ...), override # this row in your own profile's cordis.patch.yml with that one extra # name — restating the whole `config`, since a later layer replaces a # row's config rather than deep-merging it. Non-credential names # (PATH, HOME, the OUROBOROS_* selectors) survive the scrub on their # own; the OUROBOROS_* rows below are here to keep the contract ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[integrations/dsh-plugin/cordis.patch.yml:80-97](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/722172ef096767583679d04aef5e847458fee6b2/integrations/dsh-plugin/cordis.patch.yml#L80-L97) 环境值、超时和软失败。
查看原文（18行） ```text env: OUROBOROS_LLM_BACKEND: !!js process.env.OUROBOROS_LLM_BACKEND ?? '' OUROBOROS_AGENT_RUNTIME: !!js process.env.OUROBOROS_AGENT_RUNTIME || 'host' OUROBOROS_DSH_CONFIG_PATH: !!js process.env.OUROBOROS_DSH_CONFIG_PATH ?? '' OUROBOROS_DSH_CLI_PATH: !!js process.env.OUROBOROS_DSH_CLI_PATH ?? '' ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: !!js process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY ?? '' DEEPSEEK_API_KEY: !!js process.env.DEEPSEEK_API_KEY ?? '' # ouroboros_auto runs a full interview -> Seed -> execute -> grade # pipeline synchronously when called without polling; give it real # headroom instead of dsh's 60s mcp-client default. toolCallTimeoutMs: 1800000 # Soft-fail: a machine without `uv`/Ouroboros configured yet should # still boot dsh with every other plugin working, not crash outright. # Recovery is not guaranteed to be automatic — whether mcp-client # retries at all depends on the dsh build (the published rc has no # reconnect loop), and where it exists the attempt budget is bounded. # After fixing the cause, reload the plugin or restart dsh. failOnStartupError: false ```
#### 缺口 - 本轮未运行 DSH、MCP、uvx 或模型 **影响**：无法证明工具注册、后端可用与真实任务成功 **进一步探讨**：锁定引擎和宿主版本后用隔离项目核验 ### Q03 · 工具可列出是否代表访谈与执行可用？ **研究主题**：缺陷与关键质疑、功能与机制 #### 完整回答 否。README 称 OUROBOROS_LLM_BACKEND=dsh 会另启 dsh-acp-demo，要求绝对可信 composition 和可执行入口；缺失仍可能列出工具而调用访谈、Seed 或 QA 才失败。默认 host 是执行 runtime，不能据此推断访谈后端已配置或认证有效。启动错误软失败，自动重连依宿主版本，作者建议修复后重载或重启；不应把 DSH 启动成功当成工作流成功。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[integrations/dsh-plugin/README.md:47-52](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/722172ef096767583679d04aef5e847458fee6b2/integrations/dsh-plugin/README.md#L47-L52) 执行 runtime 与 LLM backend 为不同配置。 ```text | Variable | Purpose | |---|---| | `OUROBOROS_AGENT_RUNTIME` | Agent runtime for `ooo run`/`ooo auto`'s execution step. Defaults to `host` (dsh's own model does the work — see below); set to `claude-cli`, `codex`, `opencode`, ... to use that CLI instead. | | `OUROBOROS_LLM_BACKEND` | LLM backend for interview/Seed/QA. Leave unset to keep your `ouroboros setup` default. `dsh` routes those calls through DeepSeek Harness — read the next section first, it needs two more variables. | | `OUROBOROS_DSH_CONFIG_PATH` | Absolute path to the trusted Cordis composition the `dsh` LLM backend loads. Required whenever `OUROBOROS_LLM_BACKEND=dsh`. | | `OUROBOROS_DSH_CLI_PATH` | Path to the `dsh-acp-demo` bin, when it isn't on `PATH`. | ``` **依据 2 · 源码核查**：[integrations/dsh-plugin/README.md:59-82](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/722172ef096767583679d04aef5e847458fee6b2/integrations/dsh-plugin/README.md#L59-L82) dsh 后端独立子进程及实际调用失败边界。
查看原文（24行） ```text ### Routing interview/Seed/QA back through DeepSeek Harness `OUROBOROS_LLM_BACKEND=dsh` is not a one-variable switch, and it does not reuse the dsh process you're already running. Ouroboros spawns **its own** `dsh-acp-demo` ACP child, and that child fails closed with `invalid_config` unless it is given a composition to load. To use it: 1. Build DeepSeek Harness from source (`pnpm install && pnpm run build`, Node.js >= 22) and make its `dsh-acp-demo` bin reachable — on `PATH`, or named by `OUROBOROS_DSH_CLI_PATH`. A source build is the working path today: installing the published `@deepseek-ai/dsh-acp-demo` still fails on a peer-dependency conflict inside its own `dsh-tool-bash` chain. 2. Point `OUROBOROS_DSH_CONFIG_PATH` at an **absolute** composition file. Relative paths are rejected on purpose (they would resolve against the untrusted project cwd). The file must sit where dsh's `node_modules` (or workspace) is reachable: plugin package names in a composition resolve relative to the composition file's own directory. 3. Provide whatever credential that composition names — `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` for DeepSeek's own models. See the credentials note below: it must be present in the dsh host environment, and this bundle forwards it explicitly. Without steps 1–2 the Ouroboros tools still register and list fine; the first interview/Seed/QA call is what fails. Everything except the `dsh` backend works without them. ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[integrations/dsh-plugin/README.md:105-116](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/722172ef096767583679d04aef5e847458fee6b2/integrations/dsh-plugin/README.md#L105-L116) 软失败和恢复行为为作者描述。
查看原文（12行） ```text ## Startup failures and recovery Connection failures are non-fatal (`failOnStartupError: false`): a machine without `uv` on `PATH` yet still boots dsh normally, just without the Ouroboros tools, and every other plugin keeps working. Recovery is not automatic in general. Whether `mcp-client` retries at all depends on your dsh build — the published `0.0.1-rc.1` has no reconnect loop, current `main` has one with bounded exponential backoff that gives up after a capped number of consecutive failures. Either way, after fixing the cause (installing `uv`, setting a runtime), reload the plugin or restart dsh rather than waiting for a reconnect. ```

Its subprocess seam scrubs every credential-shaped name — anything matching `/KEY|PASSWORD|SECRET|TOKEN/i` — plus every `DSH_*` name, so harness credentials never leak into a spawned process implicitly. A plugin's explicit `env` layer merges after that scrub. So this bundle names a short allowlist rather than passing everything through: - `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` — Ouroboros' default LLM backend. - `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` — the `dsh` backend loopback above. A later layer replaces a row's entire `config` rather than deep-merging it, so copy this bundle's `config` block and add your line to it. Build DeepSeek Harness from source (`pnpm install && pnpm run build`, Node.js >= 22) and make its `dsh-acp-demo` bin reachable — on `PATH`, or named by `OUROBOROS_DSH_CLI_PATH`. Provide whatever credential that composition names — `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` for DeepSeek's own models. See the credentials note below: it must be present in the dsh host environment, and this bundle forwards it explicitly.
